recognize_zh: 流式細胞儀母細胞閘中 CD33 對 CD13 作圖，69.81% 母細胞為 CD33+CD13+，另有 23.42% 為 CD33+CD13-，確認母細胞屬骨髓系譜系。
features: Dot plot gated on blasts: CD33-PC5.5 (y-axis) versus CD13-PE (x-axis)
CD33+CD13- subset (23.42%) forming a tail toward lower CD13 intensity
describe_en: Flow cytometric dot plot gated on blasts shows CD33 versus CD13. Most blasts co-express CD33 and CD13 (69.81%), with an additional CD33-positive CD13-negative subset (23.42%); nearly all gated blasts are therefore CD33-positive. These findings support myeloid lineage of the blast population. Specific subclassification such as inv(3)/t(3;3) requires cytogenetic confirmation.

ddx.dx: B- or T-lymphoblastic leukemia with myeloid antigen expression
ddx.vs: Lymphoblasts may aberrantly express CD13/CD33 but carry lineage-defining CD19/CD79a or cytoplasmic CD3 and lack MPO.
BPDCN is CD4+CD56+CD123bright TCL1+ and usually CD13/CD33 negative or weak, unlike this strongly CD33+ population.
